record.dic_text:
0392 'Akziyb {akh-zi:v'}

源自 0391; 專有名詞 地名

欽定本 - Achzib 4; 4

亞革悉 = "欺騙"
1) 猶大西邊低地的小鎮
2) 亞設的城, 位於加利利海邊

0392 'Akziyb {ak-zeeb'}

from 0391;; n pr loc

AV - Achzib 4; 4

Achzib = "deceit"
1) a town in the lowland of west Judah
2) a town in Asher by the Sea of Galilee
